note: Fixture specs and window conditions for make_gate_flow.py. Every city is a disposable FT city on the owned rig. Times are game time on day 3; minutes count from 00:00.

declared_pace.source: Decision 3: about 3.3 real seconds per game minute at speed 1 and factor 1/3 on the 6 November rig

checkpoint_rule: A window checkpoint is saved checkpoint_lead_game_minutes before the window start. After load, readiness and the 60 s warm-up, measurement starts when the game clock reaches the window start, so both builds start at the same game minute. A window whose clock has passed the start by more than 1 game minute is aborted and rerun.

FT-F4-Declared.content: Fresh city at the head build, aged to day 3 so F5g fill has reached its targets, with three staffed and stocked player food shops on one district and the F6 economy at defaults (wages, households, journal, rival limits). The owned car is parked by the dense street for S-drive.
FT-F4-Declared.business_load: The native rivals the city contains plus the three owned shops
FT-F4-Declared.provenance: produce_fixture.py (existing) plus pending RIG-SHOPFIX for the staffed shops

args.rule: dense street: the street through owned-shop-1's district with the highest median pedestrian count in a 10-minute 18:00 survey at prep; sweep kerb points 200 m apart along it; kerb points off walking lines (F2 plan check 1 placement). Positions are recorded once and reused by every build.
